newsitem.title: UK: London shares start mixed, weaker bonds weigh.
newsitem.headline: London shares start mixed, weaker bonds weigh.

text.p: UK shares started mixed to higher on Tuesday as a weaker bond market unsettled investor enthusiasm.
But Wall Street's record finish last Friday provided some cheer to cash-rich institutional investors looking to buy into the market, dealers said.
"The Bund has been hammered this morning after the French election result but the overall tone is still fairly bullish," one senior dealer said.
"The banking stocks should keep the market afloat today."
The FTSE 100 was up 8.1 points to 4,669.9 by 0740 GMT.
